profile.headline: Software Developer at Micron
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer, I specialize in backend development using Java and Spring, within a Canary Deployment environment. I work with multiple services and APIs, leveraging my expertise in object-oriented programming and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices. I actively participate in daily meetings and design reviews based on agile methodologies, offering insights and evaluations to implement or enhance the application's functionality. I also conduct thorough testing and monitoring of tools and components integrated into the application to ensure optimal performance. I create, maintain, and monitor automation scripts designed to comprehensively test the application's features and user interface using Node.js/WebdriverIO and or Java/Selenium.

I completed a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science at the University of South Florida, where I have learned various concepts and skills related to web development, data structures, algorithms, and software engineering. I have also completed a Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering (which is very similar as Computer Science in my Country) at Universidad del Norte, where I was selected as a distinguished student and part of the dean's list due to my high GPA. I am eager to keep learning, accumulate experience from co-workers, and contribute to team success through discipline, determination, and hard work. I am motivated by excellence in every IT industry personal project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Backend Software Developer, specializing in Java and Spring Boot, within an iterative delivery, canary deployment and Microservices architecture. Responsibilities included daily work with multiple services and APIs, leveraging expertise in object-oriented programming and Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices. In this role, responsible as well for the following key duties: 
● Actively participated in daily meetings and design reviews based on agile methodologies, offering insights and evaluations to implement or enhance the application's functionality. 
● Conducted thorough testing and monitoring of tools and components integrated into the application to ensure optimal performance. 
● Created, maintained, and monitored automation scripts designed to comprehensively test various use cases for different features. Additionally, focused on improving the efficiency and effectiveness of existing automation processes.
